newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Corp to offer 104 midwest sites.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Corp to offer 104 midwest sites.

text.p: Coastal Mart Inc., a subsidiary of The Coastal Corporation, said Wednesday it will offer for sale 104 sites in the midwestern United States.

The company said this includes 93 operating Coastal Mart retail gasoline/convenience stores, eight closed stores and three land sites in Kansas, Iowa, South Dakota, Nebraska, Illinois, Missouri and Oklahoma.
Coastal Mart said it expects to close sales on most of these assets by year-end 1996.
The company said the sale of these properties is part of its long-term effort to concentrate company-operated stores within larger mid-continent urban markets.
"We won't state publicly what we estimate to get for the stores," said company spokesman Brian Mitchell in a phone interview.
